briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Strike the Broken Rune Arrival Span: Name at the Gate. Enter Broken Rune Arrival Span on Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate while the Gate remains Ruin Gate with active oath memory. Reference deity voice is Freyja, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, cross the threshold in the elite-tuned Broken Rune Arrival Span, secure the first route marker, and mark the Gate law before the Hollow can read the name.

missionIntro.speaker: Freyja Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The oath hears footsteps before thunder. The Broken Rune Arrival Span will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the entry pressure of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: lightning that strikes cowardice before armor

victory.speaker: Freyja Divine Voice
victory.text: The storm has heard the oath and left it standing.

defeat.speaker: Freyja Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Thunder-Oath Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Broken Rune Arrival Span as part of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Broken Rune Arrival Span as a entry node in Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet; storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
